summary: The pedestrian and creator kit is authored by code recipes (tools/assets/src/recipes/{people,head,wear}.ts, parameters in content/art/people.json). No third-party file was imported, so no intake record and no licensed provenance record exist for it; every provenance record is origin authored (LicenseRef-DeeVerse-Owned) or derived from an authored file (the portraits).

reasons: The Standard download is an itch.io checkout flow (a form with a price field), not a file the build container can fetch by a pinned URL; scraping it would not give a hash-pinned source.
The pack lists Teen proportions beside Superhero and Regular; each file would need the adult check of tools/assets/src/import/character.ts, and the bases read stylized (the art-source study).
candidates.path: inspectBase, snapRestPose and incomingBases in tools/assets/src/import/character.ts are ready: a base dropped into content-incoming/quaternius/ is inspected (22 bones, rest pose within 1 cm of BONE_REST, at most 4 influences, adult stature and head) before any use, and needs an intake record and a vetting review like any licensed file.

reasons: MakeHuman is AGPL code; its use needs an Architect ADR at session start, which this session did not have (milestone Scope in).
Raw character files may not be distributed (the web build serves raw GLBs); the milestone rejects it.

rules.V-PERSON: pass: no scan, no photo and no target image was an input; faces are the skull recipe plus 24 sliders and a seeded table, the face presets carry neighbourhood names that name no person
rules.V-LOGO: pass: no garment holds text, a logo or a mark; the cloth atlas pages hold weave, twill, rib, rip-stop, pebble and check patterns only
rules.adult: pass: every body is 1.55 to 1.95 m and its head is under 1/6.5 of the stature (tools/assets/test/import.character.spec.ts, recipes.people.spec.ts); no child proportion exists in the kit

notDone: anim/ped.moves from the Universal Animation Library: the library is an itch.io download too; the placeholder clips of the mannequin rig stay (BD-M10d4-06).
